mapAttribution: Schematic polity extents for Europa Strata — coast-templated WGS84 rings, not cadastral borders. Historical composites (empires, partitions, unifications) differ from modern ISO fills where control diverged.
narrative: From the Congress of Vienna through German and Italian unification, the Eastern Question and two world wars, Cold War division, and post-1991 nation-state Europe—borders track empires collapsing into nations, then blocs, then EU-era sovereignty.
notes: Ticks 1815 (Vienna), 1871 (German Empire / Third Republic), 1914 (July Crisis), 1945 (occupation & Soviet sphere), 1990 (reunification / late USSR / late SFRY), 2000 (post-Yugoslav & post-Soviet map). Overseas colonies omitted. Sources: Congress treaties, Euratlas/Shepherd tradition, Balkan Wars & peace settlements, Cold War atlases.
